title: Privilege review automation playbook and SCIM provenance bundler
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Enterprise customers require repeatable, auditable artifacts for periodic access reviews that combine RBAC snapshots, SCIM provenance streams, and identity assertions from SSO/SAML. Current exports are fragmented (interactive & manual), retention settings are applied inconsistently across tenants, and evidence generation is often delayed beyond audit windows.

Goal: Build an automated privilege review orchestration that: (1) periodically compiles per-tenant access snapshots with RBAC role mappings, group memberships, and active sessions; (2) attaches SCIM delta provenance (who/what/when) and SSO assertion metadata; (3) applies tenant-specific residency and retention policies when packaging evidence; and (4) exposes both an auditor-friendly bundle and a lightweight reviewer UI for owners to certify or revoke access.

Scope: Engineer a backend orchestrator + storage policy engine and audit-bundle format compatible with our evidence pipeline. Integrations: Identity (SCIM export, change stream), SSO/SAML assertion logs (via auth proxy), RBAC graph exporter, KMS-tagged evidence manifests, and the Console review UI. Exclude immediate migration of legacy manual exports — create migration adapter as follow-up.

Success metrics: (a) Reduce manual evidence assembly time from avg 3.5 hours to < 10 minutes per tenant, (b) first-time pass rate in internal compliance audits >= 95%, (c) reviewer completion rate within 7 days after bundle publish >= 90%.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Scheduled job produces a signed evidence bundle (JSONL + manifest) per tenant respecting retention/residency tags; 2) Bundle includes RBAC snapshot, SCIM delta provenance, SSO assertion sample, and links to policy decisions; 3) Console shows pending reviews with per-user risk tags and one-click certify/revoke that writes audit events; 4) KMS envelope encryption applied and audit logs stored per tenant residency rules; 5) End-to-end e2e test and demo runbook exist.

Rollout plan: Canary to 3 pilot tenants (security-conscious customers) for one review cycle, collect feedback, then ramp to 50 tenants and enable auto-archive. Provide a migration adapter to convert previous CSV exports into new bundles.

Risks & mitigations: Data residency complexity — mitigate with residency-aware storage router and retention enforcement; SCIM latency on large orgs — implement streaming deltas and snapshot sharding; reviewer overload — supply risk heuristics and batching suggestions.

2026-03-03: Engineering spike completed: streaming SCIM deltas can be reliably replayed for orgs up to 250k members using shard keys; estimated storage for full snapshot ~120MB per 100k users. Opted for JSONL bundle format with manifest and signature. — Arjun

2026-03-05: Security review notes: require KMS wrapping + HMAC for evidence integrity, retention policy enforcement must be auditable. Raised follow-up on key rotation implications. — Jordan (Security)
2026-03-09: Implementation: initial orchestrator scaffolding merged (PR #1287). Exports use residency tag 3-letter codes; next: integrate SSO assertion sampler and Console inbox. — Arjun
2026-03-12: PM feedback: include reviewer escalation flow (automated notify + SLA) and add a 'mark-as-no-change' quick path for low-risk owners. — Priya
